rationale: The discourse has clarified the technical feasibility of deep hybrid/no-closure options, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee/state actors insist on binding no-closure and no-forced-layoff guarantees, while management/owners/investors still keep closures and redundancies on the table if economics require them. The last two rounds show repetition with some quantitative refinement, but no substantive convergence on the non-negotiable trade-off.
